activity.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
activity.replacement_contract: Typed activity relaxations retain exact wiring and certified word branch numbers, including mixed uBlock graphs. The returned lower bound is distinguished from the exact differential optimum; concrete traces are admitted and small instances are solved.

algebraic.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
algebraic.replacement_contract: Sparse Boolean polynomial systems and typed monomial models replace Sage-owned rings. Truth-table/cube evaluation checks small instances; solver completeness and limits are explicit. Licensed large legacy runs are not inferred from portable tests.

avalanche.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
avalanche.replacement_contract: Empirical paired flip counts and dependence/weight/entropy are retained. Shared explicit samples check numerical meaning. Sample-dependent significance rules and the seeded NumPy sampling stream are intentional v5 improvements.

boomerang.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
boomerang.replacement_contract: Restored whole-trail ARX search composes two outer characteristics with the original large-switch subset. Independent exact carry/borrow counts check switches. Outer weight, local probability and sampled full-quartet rate are distinct claims.

catalogue.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
catalogue.replacement_contract: Declared constructors and typed component metadata replace dynamic Sage/package scanning. Pinned paired vectors and explicit constructor contracts are separate from mere import/discovery checks.

components.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
components.replacement_contract: Typed semantic components replace legacy component subclasses. Exact small-width functional miters, lookup tables and property tests check behavior separately from SAT/SMT/MILP/CP serialization. Unsupported domains remain explicit errors.

composed.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
composed.replacement_contract: Differential-linear and shared-difference paired models retain their distinct constraints, signs and normalization; checked small examples and real solver witnesses replace old parser/string assertions.

continuous.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
continuous.replacement_contract: The generalized evaluator and CP differential heuristic are different models. Both are retained separately; Boolean-correct default carries and explicit legacy traversal are tested against fixed legacy vectors. Float search results remain heuristic.

editing.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
editing.replacement_contract: Typed immutable cuts, joined selections, key-injection removal and inversion replace editor mutations. Witnesses check evaluation and exact boundary values, not historical component IDs.

evaluation.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
evaluation.replacement_contract: Scalar, batch and generated execution retain packed-bit meaning. Numerical fixtures and checked traces are the evidence; generated legacy source strings and compiler internals are intentionally replaced.

functional.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
functional.replacement_contract: Graph-wide exact functional constraints replace backend-specific generated strings. Exhaustive small-input miters are solved by four backends, and recovered inputs are checked by scalar evaluation. Prime-field and unsupported component domains are rejected explicitly.

graph.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
graph.replacement_contract: Immutable typed graph and explicit selections replace mutable DTOs, rounds and component state. Graph construction, unit boundaries and observation values are checked; old mutable object layouts are not a compatibility contract.

helpers.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
helpers.replacement_contract: Typed boundary and arithmetic utilities replace legacy ID suffixes, name maps, and general mutable helper functions. Stable numerical/selection contracts are checked; obsolete storage and code-string conventions are not scientific capabilities.

neural.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
neural.replacement_contract: MSB-first dataset projections, architecture/loss defaults and independent holdout decisions are retained or explicitly specified. Seeded streams and two-sided sample-dependent significance are deliberate improvements; stochastic learning curves need not be identical.

paired.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
paired.replacement_contract: Paired typed graphs retain the two related executions and explicit shared differences; generated mutable CompoundXorDifferentialCipher objects are replaced.

reporting.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
reporting.replacement_contract: Result-owned reports and typed tables preserve numerical content across terminal, CSV/dataframe, plots and LaTeX. Old mutable Report internals, templates and cosmetic strings are replaced rather than asserted byte-identical.

solvers.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
solvers.replacement_contract: Class-based solver drivers retain portable status, assignments, objective and limits. Last-incumbent parsing, UNKNOWN, partial output, primal validation and process cleanup are tested. A substituted executable is not claimed to reproduce every vendor tuning parameter.

statistics.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
statistics.replacement_contract: Native NIST numerical definitions, original API, 21 templates and 52 original tests remain distinct from external NIST/Dieharder drivers. Dataset partitions, bit order and non-byte-aligned transport are checked; process smoke tests are not statistical certification.

trails.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
trails.replacement_contract: Exact rational component products, signs, bounded enumeration and checked decoded trails replace backend-owned dictionaries. The capability matrix records construction separately from materialization, solving and witness validation.

truncated.claim: scoped executable replacement contracts, not whole-module or whole-legacy equivalence
truncated.replacement_contract: Bitwise and wordwise truncated domains are separate typed relations. Exhaustive local relations and checked impossible/paired witnesses replace helper string layouts; search restrictions are not promoted to concrete-security proofs.

scope: 207 historical supersede decisions reviewed as scoped semantic replacements; eight historical remove decisions are reviewed separately. New or changed source needs renewed review, not an automatically inherited parity label.
